test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A thief saw a policeman from a distance of 300 m and started running. At the same time, the policeman started chasing the thief. If the speed of the thief is 12 km/h and that of the policeman 15 km/h, then the distance (in km) covered by the policeman to catch the thief is:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between thief and policeman = 300 m = 0.3 km

Speed of the thief = 12 km/h

Speed of the policeman = 15 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of policeman - Speed of thief

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

Distance covered by policeman = Speed of policeman × Time

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = 15 - 12 = 3 km/h

Time taken to catch the thief = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 0.3 / 3

⇒ Time = 0.1 hours

Distance covered by the policeman = Speed of policeman × Time

⇒ Distance = 15 × 0.1

⇒ Distance = 1.5 km

**The distance covered by the policeman to catch the thief is 1.5 km.**
